title: How the Web Works
explanation: Understanding the client-server model, requests/responses, and the basics of web architecture.

title: HTTP & HTTPS
explanation: Understanding protocols, methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE), status codes, headers, cookies, and security with HTTPS.

title: DNS & Domain Names
explanation: How domain names are resolved, DNS servers, IP addresses, subdomains, and TTL.

title: Browser Rendering
explanation: How browsers render pages, critical rendering path, layout, paint, reflow, and repaint.

title: Web Security Basics
explanation: CORS, Content Security Policy, SSL/TLS, XSS, CSRF, and other basic web security concepts.

title: Web Performance
explanation: Latency, caching, CDN, resource optimization, HTTP/2, lazy loading, and optimizing load times.

title: Accessibility (A11y)
explanation: Making websites accessible to everyone: screen readers, ARIA roles, keyboard navigation, color contrast.

title: Web Standards & Protocols
explanation: W3C, WHATWG standards, HTML5 specs (conceptually), CSSOM, DOM, and maintaining cross-browser compatibility.

title: Progressive Web Apps (PWA)
explanation: Understanding service workers, offline capabilities, app manifest, and push notifications.

title: Web APIs
explanation: Browser APIs (Fetch, Storage, Geolocation, etc.) and how they enable web features without diving into JS code.
